# Agent Plugins 1.0.0 schemas (vendored)

`plugin.schema.json` and `mcp.schema.json`, unchanged, from
https://github.com/agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec/tree/d92e6f443b8edcea42c039727a82afdc565779e2/schemas/1.0.0
(also served at `https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/`), copied 2026-10-19.

The spec repository licenses its schemas under the Apache License 2.0 (its
`LICENSE.md` and `LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt`; it has no NOTICE file). The licence
text is in this repository's `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

`runtime/test/host-packages.test.mjs` validates the built Agent Plugins package
against them, with the small validator in `runtime/testkit/json-schema-lite.mjs`.
